label: Steampunk
blurb: Brass, steam and clockwork: airship captains, sky pirates, gadget-slinging outlaws and inventors on a lawless frontier where the railway ends and the smog begins.
context: steampunk character, Victorian-inspired clothing with brass and leather details
hobbies: tinkering with a pocket-watch that tells more than time
cataloguing beetles under a brass microscope
playing cards on the observation deck
flying kites from the airship mooring tower
brewing strong tea in a copper samovar
writing letters to the Royal Society
reading the stars with a brass sextant
trading tall tales at the dockside pub
quirks: wearing goggles pushed up even indoors
tapping every pipe to hear if it rings true
checking the barometer before every decision
taking notes in a tiny leather notebook
sniffing the air for coal smoke
carrying a spanner everywhere, just in case
talking to {poss} airship as if it were a horse
goals: building an airship faster than any other
patenting an invention before a rival steals it
paying off the debt on {poss} workshop
clearing {poss} name of a crime {subj} didn't commit
earning a seat at the Inventors' Guild
mapping the storm fronts beyond the frontier
tracking down the outlaw who robbed {poss} family
opening a clockwork repair shop of {poss} own
retiring to a quiet cottage without a single gear in it
peeves: a whistle that won't stop screeching
a pocket-watch running two minutes slow
sky pirates who don't keep their word
people who call it 'just a machine'
accessories: brass goggles pushed up on the forehead
a top hat with a small gear band
a mechanical arm brace of polished brass
a pocket-watch on a long gold chain
a leather tool roll on the belt
a clockwork bird perched on one shoulder
a brass spyglass on a strap
a pistol with copper coils in a hip holster
a monocle with extra magnifying lenses
a steam-powered backpack with small pipes
a mechanical pet beetle in one hand
a cane with a brass gear-shaped head
a parasol lined with copper wire
default_outfits: a brown leather waistcoat over a linen shirt with rolled sleeves, trousers with braces and buckled boots

default_outfits.t: a brown leather corset over a high-collared blouse, a bustled skirt and buckled boots
a tweed waistcoat over a collarless shirt, a cravat, trousers and buckled boots

_tables: The next entries replace the shared tables in common.json for this setting only (same shape): Victorian-inspired hair, whiskers, goggles and brass marks, and no modern dyed colours. Every hair label names 'hair' so the roller never adds ' hairstyle'.
